Aisha Khan: Heads-up: we're prototyping per-tenant retention for SIEM exports. goal: default 30d, tenant override up to 365d with signed approver flow. Need RBAC + KMS JIT unwrap design.
Tom Reyes: Nice. Is the tenant override opt-in via a signed CSV + legal approval?
Aisha Khan: Yes. UX: request in Console -> attach justification -> chain-of-approvers (security + legal) -> if approved, tag tenant with retention:extended=365d.
Nora Chen: Operational question: where do we store extended archives keys? We should avoid having many long-lived CMKs. Thinking: envelope keys per-tenant, but keep master CMK wrapped by HSM with JIT unwrap policy.
Tom Reyes: Agree. Proposed flow:
1) Exporter writes encrypted blob using tenant-specific data key (DEK).
2) DEK is wrapped by a tenant KMS key version (KEK).
3) KEK is itself protected by a master-wrapping key in HSM (no direct developer access).
4) For extended retention, KEK is marked non-rotatable until expiry or legal revoke.
Nora Chen: To prevent developer access, unwrap APIs must require a ticket id and a signed JWT from the approval service. No direct IAM perms for dev roles.
Aisha Khan: Good. RBAC changes suggested:
- add role: log-export-reader (read-only, 30d view limit)
- add role: archive-unwrapper (timeboxed, requires ticket)
- remove list-objects permission from dev-general
sec-bot: PR created by @Tom Reyes: https://git.example/repo/policy/pull/99 - adds archive-unwrapper role :gear: 
Tom Reyes: For audit trail, every unwrap must create an immutable event in audit-log: { actor, ticket, keyid, nonce, timestamp }. We should also emit a SIEM event.
Nora Chen: Replay plan: we support a read-replay svc account that can rehydrate archived blobs into a sandbox SIEM for triage. That svc account only has unwrap via KMS proxy when flagged by the ticketing system.
Aisha Khan: Example ticket flow (very short):
- sec-oncall files ticket ENGSEC-802 with selectors
- manager approves -> legal if >90d -> approval-service emits signed JWT
- KMS-proxy verifies JWT audience + ttl -> returns temporary unwrap token (1h)
- replay job uses unwrap token to get DEKs and rehydrate blobs
Tom Reyes: cURL example for KMS-proxy unwrap (internal):
curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/unwrap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <signed-jwt>" \
  -d '{"key_id":"tenant-123/keK-v3","ciphertext":"..."}'
Nora Chen: OPA policy will enforce ticket bindings and allowed reasons. We'll add rego rule: allow_unwrap { input.ticket in data.tickets.approved; input.actor == data.roles.archive_unwrapper }
Aisha Khan: Backups: if master HSM key is rotated, ensure KEKs stay re-wrappable. We'll keep a rotation registry and a key-rotation playbook.
Tom Reyes: Testing items:
- simulate ticket approval -> unwrap -> rehydrate -> confirm audit event
- try unwrap with dev token -> should fail (403)
- expire JWT -> unwrap should fail (401)
- stress test rehydrate path for large bursts (rate limit unwraps)
sec-bot: Created task #SEC-802 (tenant retention flow) and pinged @legal-team :white_check_mark:
Nora Chen: We should limit number of concurrent unwraps per tenant to reduce blast radius (rate-limit and circuit-breaker).
Aisha Khan: Can someone own the legal-approval checklist? @legal-team can you confirm required fields for extended retention?
legal-team: We'll add required fields: business justification, data minimization plan, retention end-date, custodian contact. Also require periodic re-review every 90 days for >180d approvals.
Tom Reyes: Rollout plan:
- week 1: alpha behind feature flag (security + legal only)
- week 2: staged rollout to customers who requested extension (manual approvals)
- week 3: GA with console UI + automated approval gating
Nora Chen: Observability: emit unwrap-rate, unwrap-failures, approved-extensions metrics to infra-monitoring. Add alert if unwrap-failures > 0.5% in 1h.
Aisha Khan: Owner assignments: Nora -> KMS proxy + OPA rules; Tom -> RBAC + exporter changes; Aisha -> approval-service + console flow; legal-team -> approval checklist.
Tom Reyes: I'll open a PR for RBAC changes and a draft Rego policy.
sec-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled 2024-06-12T16:00:00Z by @Aisha Khan
Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone. Post any remaining edge cases here. If no objections, we merge RBAC PR tomorrow. :thumbsup:
